title: Systemic outcomes following maxillomandibular advancement for obstructive sleep apnea: systematic review and meta-analysis
html: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common sleep disorder associated with an elevated risk of systemic comorbidities. Maxillomandibular advancement (MMA) surgery can reduce upper airway obstruction and improve sleep parameters, but its systemic health benefits remain less well characterized. This systematic review and meta-analysis was performed to synthesize evidence on the systemic health outcomes associated with MMA in patients with OSA. A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus, and Web of Science from inception through May 20, 2026.
